name: Darwin
overview: Scripture clearly affirms that God is the Creator of all things, having made the heavens and the earth at the beginning (Genesis 1:1). He sovereignly brought forth living creatures according to their kinds, demonstrating intentional design and order in creation (Genesis 1:24). Humanity holds a unique place as God’s image-bearers, specially formed by His hand and given dominion over the earth and its creatures (Genesis 1:26; 2:7). The natural world, including beasts and birds, reflects the manifold wisdom and richness of God's works (Job 12:7; Psalms 104:24), underscoring His purposeful and wise creation rather than random evolutionary processes.
